items.title: Between the pages
items.description:
一本没人愿意翻开的旧书，一座困在同一天里的村庄，一个只有你还记得昨天的清晨。

拿起你的诗人身份，与村民对话，判断谁在说真话，谁在回避什么，你问的方式决定他们愿意告诉你多少。拼凑出真相，讲给这个世界听，也许你就能真正离开。
items.description_en:
An old book nobody wants to open, a village trapped in the same day, a morning where only you remember yesterday.

Take up your identity as a bard, talk to the villagers, and judge who is telling the truth and who is avoiding something. How you ask decides how much they're willing to tell you. Piece the truth together and tell it to the world, and maybe you can finally leave.

items.title: Cipher of the Blood Moon
items.description: 《Cipher of the Blood Moon》是一款以密码学为核心玩法的桌面解谜游戏。你将通过凯撒密码、维吉尼亚密码和摩斯电码，一步步破解导师留下的线索，揭开血月背后的真相，并最终决定：是继续沉默地活下去，还是把这个秘密告诉所有人。
items.description_en: Cipher of the Blood Moon is a tabletop puzzle game built around cryptography. Using the Caesar cipher, the Vigenère cipher, and Morse code, you'll decode the clues your mentor left behind step by step, uncover the truth behind the blood moon, and finally decide: keep living in silence, or tell everyone the secret.

items.title: An Eye For Value
items.description: 当铺小游戏，目前所有手头项目中推进最快的。
items.description_en: A pawnshop mini-game, currently the fastest-moving of all my projects.
